title: Hector goes to find his family
intro: Helen foresees their place in song. Hector refuses rest and seeks Andromache, who has hurried to the wall.

notes.text: φρήν, mind: nom pl; ἔμπεδος, firm / steady. Paris lacks sound judgment now and, she says, always will.
ὀπίσσω temporal, hereafter; εἰμί 3pl fut, epic -σσ-.
ἐπαυρίσκομαι, reap the result / suffer for: fut mid inf; ironic “enjoy the consequences.”
εἰσέρχομαι 2sg 2aor imperative, enter; ἕζομαι uncontracted pres imperative, sit; δίφρος here chair / stool, not chariot.
ἀμφιβαίνω 3sg perf act, surrounds / besets; πόνος, hardship, subject; φρένας acc, your mind.
ἄτη, ruinous folly / blindness: gen sg; Paris' disastrous act.
πέλω, be: 1pl pres mid subj, purpose / result, “so we may become subjects of song”; ἀοίδιμος, sung of.
εἰμί fut ptc dat pl, “for people yet to come.” Helen imagines future poetry about their suffering.
καθίζω, seat / bid sit: 2sg pres imperative, negated; φιλέω pres ptc + περ, “kind though you are.”
ἐπισεύω perf mid/pass 3sg, “my spirit is set on / eager”; perfect state, not a new rush.
ἐπαμύνω, defend / help: 1sg pres subj + dat Trojans; “to go to their aid.”
ποθή, longing / need; ἐμεῖο = ἐμοῦ; ἄπειμι pres ptc gen sg, absent. “They sorely miss me in my absence.”
ὄρνυμι 2sg pres imperative, rouse him; ἐπείγομαι 3sg pres imperative, let him hurry himself.
ἔντοσθεν + gen, inside; καταμάρπτω, catch up: 3sg aor subj; purpose after ὥς κε.
ἔρχομαι 1sg fut mid; εἶδον 1sg 2aor mid subj, see; purpose, to see his household.
οἰκεύς, household member / servant: acc pl; distinct from his wife and son, then named separately.
σφιν dat pl, to them; ὑπότροπος, returning; ἱκνέομαι fut mid 1sg. He doubts whether he will come home again.
ἦ, or; δαμάω / δαμάζω, subdue: epic 3pl fut, expanded δαμῶσιν. The indirect question pairs ἵξομαι, will I return, with will the gods bring me down?
αἶψα, quickly; ναιετάω, dwell: pres ptc acc pl with house, “well-inhabited / pleasantly situated.”
λευκώλενος, white-armed; ἀμφίπολος, attendant; ἐΰπεπλος, well-robed: dat sg.
ἐφίστημι 3sg plup, stood on the tower; γοάω, lament: expanded pres ptc; μύρομαι, weep: pres mid ptc.
τέτμον, find / meet: reduplicated 3sg aor, no familiar present counterpart; ἄκοιτις, wife: acc sg.
οὐδός, threshold: acc sg; δμῳή, enslaved woman: dat pl.
νημερτής, unerring / true: acc neut pl; μυθέομαι 2pl aor mid imperative, tell truly.
πῇ, where / which way; βαίνω 3sg root aor.
γαλόως, husband's sister; εἰνάτηρ, husband's brother's wife: gen pl. ἐς + gen implies their houses.
ἐξοίχομαι 3sg pres, has gone out, with completed-departure sense; Ἀθηναίης gen, temple understood after ἐς.
ἐϋπλόκαμος, lovely-tressed; ἱλάσκομαι, propitiate / seek favour: 3pl pres mid.
